title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
title_zh: StreamArena：面向连续、交互式、长时程智能体流式视频理解
abstract_en: Deploying autonomous multimodal agents in continuous, real-world environments requires them to ingest unbounded audio-visual streams and maintain hour-scale memory. However, current evaluations predominantly rely on brief clips and multiple-choice formats. This design allows minimal baselines that process only the last four frames to match or surpass complex streaming models, while answer options also expose language shortcuts. We introduce StreamArena, a benchmark for hour-scale, interactive streaming video understanding. StreamArena contains 243 full-length videos averaging 88.8 minutes and 3,646 rigorously annotated, open-ended question-answer pairs that evaluate real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool utilization. Evaluation across diverse systems exposes a tension between continuous interaction and long-horizon multimodal comprehension. Methods that retain only recent frames cannot recover distant events, methods that convert past observations into text lose visual evidence, and methods that repeatedly compress visual memory struggle to preserve fine-grained details over time. We address this tension with StreamMind, a two-tier architecture that assigns latency-critical interaction and proactive monitoring to independently scheduled frontend workers, while backend workers asynchronously construct persistent multimodal memory and perform historical recall and external search. StreamMind outperforms existing streaming baselines across all four capabilities and reduces query-to-answer latency by reusing persistent state.
abstract_zh: 在连续真实环境中部署自主多模态智能体，要求系统能够处理无边界的音视频流，并维持小时级记忆。然而，现有评测多依赖短视频片段与多选题形式，使得仅处理最后四帧的简单基线也能匹敌甚至超过复杂流式模型，同时选项还可能暴露语言捷径。本文提出 StreamArena，一个面向小时级、交互式流式视频理解的基准。StreamArena 包含 243 个完整视频，平均时长 88.8 分钟，并提供 3,646 个严格标注的开放式问答对，覆盖实时感知、历史回溯、主动交互和多模态工具使用四类能力。对多种系统的评测揭示了连续交互与长时程多模态理解之间的张力：仅保留近期帧的方法无法恢复远距离事件，将历史观察转写为文本的方法会丢失视觉证据，反复压缩视觉记忆的方法难以长期保留细粒度细节。为此，作者提出 StreamMind，一种双层架构：前端 worker 独立调度，负责低延迟交互与主动监控；后端 worker 异步构建持久多模态记忆，并执行历史回忆与外部搜索。StreamMind 在四类能力上均优于现有流式基线，并通过复用持久状态降低查询到回答的延迟。
key_points_zh: 提出 StreamArena，用于评测连续、交互式、长时程 streaming video understanding，包含 243 个平均 88.8 分钟的完整视频和 3,646 个开放式 QA。
基准覆盖四类核心能力：实时感知、历史回溯、主动交互和多模态工具使用，比短片段、多选题评测更贴近真实智能体场景。
实验发现现有方法存在明显权衡：近期帧方法遗忘远期事件，文本化记忆丢失视觉证据，视觉压缩记忆难以保留长期细节。
提出 StreamMind 双层架构，将低延迟前端交互与异步后端持久多模态记忆解耦，以兼顾实时性和长时程理解。
StreamMind 在四类能力上均超过现有 streaming baselines，并通过复用持久状态降低 query-to-answer latency。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant benchmark and system paper for continuous interactive streaming video agents with long-horizon memory, proactive perception, tool use, and latency-aware architecture.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度契合领域的流式视频智能体论文，涵盖长程记忆、主动感知、工具使用和低延迟系统设计。
